deviations.item: Stability helper is not wired into the SID export; no valid modified SID export is produced by this candidate yet.
deviations.reason: The required torch runtime is unavailable in the current Python environment, preventing an end-to-end quantizer invocation and verified integration. Avoided claiming or fabricating a valid export.

deviations.item: No full frozen 3000-epoch training was run.
deviations.reason: The Python environment lacks PyTorch (ModuleNotFoundError), so model training and the required genuine forward/backward smoke could not execute.

deviations.item: The baseline experiment arm identity remains `resample` rather than being switched to a dedicated stability arm.
deviations.reason: The copied trainer enforces an import-time single-arm guard and has many arm-specific identity/path contracts. Altering these without executable runtime verification risks modifying frozen protocol behavior.

assumptions: The perturbation scale sigma defaults to 1.0 because the specification does not assign a numerical value.
The stated threshold intervals are treated as half-open with exact boundaries assigned to the higher bin; this resolves the endpoint ambiguity noted by evaluators.
The helper accepts a supplied frozen quantizer callable so it can be tested independently of a particular RQ-VAE wrapper API.

smoke.result: Python compilation passed. Required forward/backward helper smoke was attempted but blocked: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'. Thus gradient flow, finite loss, and valid candidate export are NOT verified.

notes: The candidate tree is a copy of the frozen TIGER_BEHAVIOR_SAMPLE_RQ-VAE tree with its copied logs removed and a standalone helper added. The helper computes train-item coordinate variance, deterministic seeded Gaussian views, complete-tuple modal agreement, and four stability bins. This is an incomplete implementation, not a training-ready Stage 2 result: export integration and the requested actual training smoke remain outstanding. Only the required implementation.json was written outside the candidate tree.
